stage: <a number: the stage of the plan entry this answers. The first pass writes handoff.json, a later pass handoff-stage<N>.json>
status: <working (the checkpoint, never final) | passed | blocked | rejected | escalated>
started: <ISO 8601 UTC from date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ, written at the checkpoint>
finished: <ISO 8601 UTC from the shell. Absent while status is working>
reviewed: <the snapshot sha you judged, from node .actio/bin/run.mjs snapshot <run>. Required for the owners of design, review-1of3, review-2of3, review-3of3, security, regression-guard, engineering and quality; optional for makers>
consumed: <one plain path per entry, run-relative or repo-relative, that you actually read. Include your brief slice bug-historian/brief/<agent>.md>
produced: <one plain path per entry that you wrote. Each exists and is non-empty. The handoff itself is implicit>

gates.name: <only a gate you own, by its canonical name in docs/WORKFLOW.md>

plan: <1 to 6 short lines: approach, acceptance criteria the dispatch did not state, assumptions you could not check>
Risk: <a failure mode from your ## Pre-mortem, and what you do about it (A1: at least one line starts Risk:)>

checks.criterion: <an acceptance criterion or a role check. At least one when passed>
checks.evidence: <evidence path, or the command that proves it>

findings.severity: <blocker | major | minor | nit. Only blocker and major reject>
findings.rule: <the rule id or BRAND.md section it breaks>

blockers.what: <what is wrong or missing. A missing tool is a blocker, never faked: 'supabase MCP not authorised', 'playwright MCP not answering'>

missing_inputs: <a promised input that never arrived and that you worked around>
machinery_findings: <an agent file, skill, template or script that was ambiguous or wrong, with the file named>

decisions_for_shehab.question: <the decision, stated as a choice>
decisions_for_shehab.recommendation: <your recommendation and the reason. Never a bare question>

next: <agent-name, shehab, or null at run closure. Absent while status is working>
